Definition: from G4198; travel (by land); figuratively (plural) proceedings, i.e. career:--journey(-ing), ways.
BiblicalUsage: Poreia is travel, a journey, and by extension the course of a life. Luke uses it for Jesus journeying toward Jerusalem, and James for a rich man who fades away in his ways.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every life is a journey going somewhere, and the only question is whether it ends at Jerusalem or fades away on the road.
